answer: The cost lands per head: 447 aliases need 447 records, each checked live against the issuer, so bulk forgery costs 447 times what one honest seat costs. Entry needs street theatre troupe membership: a membership the troupe renews after seasons of street shows. Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. The ember record shows the asymmetry: scale multiplies the cost but never the reward, the violet entry is checkable by anyone, and the inlet window closes before a farm can catch up.
